description: This file defines a sealed interface 'RecentSearchQueriesUiState' with two implementations, representing UI states for recent search queries: a Loading state and a Success state holding a list of recent queries.

classes.name: RecentSearchQueriesUiState
classes.description: Sealed interface representing UI states for recent search queries, with 'Loading' and 'Success' implementations.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: A singleton object representing the loading state.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Data class holding a list of recent search queries, representing the successful retrieval state.
